name: 钓鱼的爷爷
role: an old man who fishes at 后海 every night and morning
character: Quiet, patient, speaks in a low voice so as not to scare the fish. Sees everything that happens by the water at night.
knows: A white fox with many tails ran along the lake last night, towards 景山
The fish bite best at dawn

explains.狐狸: 像小狗，住在山里，很聪明。

name: 划船的师傅
role: the man who rents out boats on 后海
knows: The lakes 前海, 后海 and 西海 are called 什刹海
In winter the lake freezes and people skate

explains.后海: 北京的一个湖，在鼓楼西边。

name: 游客
role: a young woman from Xi'an taking a walk by the lake
knows: The lane 烟袋斜街 goes to 鼓楼
